summary: Retested all 9 iteration_43 playbook fixes plus a regression pass. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (test_playbooks.py updated for the new post-submit behaviour, plus new test_playbooks_iter44.py). Confirmed: a custom playbook gets order 9999 and shows up in the challenge panel with no 500 (then deleted); a re-run after submit returns recorded:false with the stored result and a separate practice result, and the instructor table keeps the first run; if there was no run before submit, the first post-submit run is stored with after_submit:true and later runs are practice only; a category mismatch returns 400; pending counts only planned/generating (51 = 47+4); tree errors name the problem step ('(empty)', a missing id, a loop, no escalate/close ending). Writer code review: the repair turn and the status=='generating' guard are both in place. UI (fresh student plus instructor): pb-panel-error shows when the request is forced to 500; panel run then Submit auto-scrolls challenge-result into view with pb-result and pb-wrong-step; a practice re-run toasts 'Practice run — your first playbook run for this alert is kept' and pb-result keeps the original verdict; /playbooks list ('24 playbooks · 51 more being written') and the detail runner reach the outcome and report; the instructor Playbook runs table renders and keeps the original row. Two minor issues: the panel error state never clears on reopen, and the word-overlap ordering counts generic words.

minor.issue: Word-overlap ordering has no stopword filter, so generic words (with, against, detected, sign, success, followed) count. ch-02-3 'Password Spray Against Cloud Sign-ins' ranks 'Entra ID Excessive Account Lockouts' (6 shared words) above 'Password Spray against Entra ID' (5). ch-02-1 'SSH Brute Force' scores a 3-way tie (Windows 4625 / Okta Impossible Travel / Entra lockouts), and Okta Impossible Travel appears 2nd in the UI panel. Suggest a stopword list (with/against/detected/from/after/followed/success/sign/playbook) and weighting title matches above trigger matches.

ui_bugs.issue: The error state is sticky. 'failed' is never reset, so after a failed load, closing and reopening the panel re-fetches successfully (verified: second request returned 200) but still shows pb-panel-error ('Please try again'). The user must reload the page. Fix: setFailed(false) before the fetch in the useEffect (or add a Retry button).

issues: Runs recorded after submission (after_submit:true) look the same as pre-submit runs. A small 'after submit' tag would stop instructors reading them as blind triage.

action_items: PlaybookPanel: reset failed=false when re-fetching (or add Retry) so the error state can recover
Optional: add stopwords and title weighting to challenge_playbooks ordering
Optional: show an after_submit marker in the instructor Playbook runs table
critical_code_review_comments: routes_playbooks.record_run: the submitted+prev guard is correct. Pre-submit re-runs still replace the earlier pre-submit run (latest pre-submit run counts), which is reasonable.

playbook_writer: the repair turn catches AssertionError/KeyError/ValueError/TypeError, and the final and failed writes are guarded by status 'generating'. Manage validate() sets status 'ready', so instructor edits are not overwritten. Every hot reload restarts ensure_playbooks and resets generating/failed to planned, so failed items are retried on each reload (fine).

routes_manage.validate: doc.setdefault('order', 9999) also runs on PUT and keeps an existing order, as long as the client sends it back. If the edit form drops 'order', a seeded playbook's order would become 9999 (not verified via UI).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 minor sticky-error bug)
